# netbox_fhrp_group (Data Source)

A first-hop redundancy protocol group (ipam.fhrpgroup).

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/ipam/fhrpgroup/):

> A first-hop redundancy protocol (FHRP) enables multiple physical interfaces to present a virtual [IP address](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/ipam/ipaddress/) (VIP) in a redundant manner. Examples of such protocols include:
>
> * [Hot Standby Router Protocol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hot_Standby_Router_Protocol) (HSRP)
> * [Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Virtual_Router_Redundancy_Protocol) (VRRP)
> * [Common Address Redundancy Protocol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_Address_Redundancy_Protocol) (CARP)
> * [Gateway Load Balancing Protocol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gateway_Load_Balancing_Protocol) (GLBP)
>
> When creating a new FHRP group, the user may optionally create a VIP as well. This IP address will be automatically assigned to the new group. (Virtual IP addresses can also be assigned after the group has been created.)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_fhrp_group" "test" {
  name = "test-fhrp_group"
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `auth_key` (String, Sensitive) Authentication key.
- `auth_type` (String) Authentication type. One of: plaintext, md5.
- `created` (String)
- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `description` (String)
- `group_id` (Number) Protocol group number (the VRRP/HSRP group id, not a reference to another object).
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `owner_group_id` (Number) Id of the owner group.
- `owner_group_name` (String) Name of the owner group.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `owner_name` (String) Name of the owner.
- `protocol` (String) Redundancy protocol. One of: vrrp2, vrrp3, carp, clusterxl, hsrp, glbp, other.
- `q` (String) Search term, matched against the fields NetBox searches for this object type.
- `related_ip` (String) Related ip to match.
- `tag_id` (Number) Id of a tag the object carries.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. An object field holds the related object's id, e.g. "12", a multiobject field a JSON list of ids in any order, e.g. jsonencode([12, 13]). A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
